title: seed: a seed row that supplies a summary (roll-up) field value is stored as written, and nothing recomputes it until a child write
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cysZsTQwxLv9M2TzHH

Out-of-scope finding (class a, to be measured by the claimant) from area a4-A's #34986 pass (os-dev report 7022810829). A seed row that supplies a value for a summary field is stored as written (isSystem), and nothing recomputes the summary until a child record is written, so a parent can show a total no child backs.
Done when: after seeding, every summary field equals its roll-up over the seeded children (recomputed, or the supplied value refused), with a test.
Dedupe read: seed, summary, roll-up, stored as written — no match.
